sentences.zh: 起初我以为是甜点，树莓派（Raspberry Pie）。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 后来我意识到 Pie 的拼写和希腊字母一样（Pi），原来它是一款看起来很酷的嵌入式电脑设备。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 一群人聚在一起说，他们想制造一款 35 美元的嵌入式电脑，运行 Linux 系统，看看人们能用它做什么。

sentences.en: So it's been a while, but we'll try to keep news to relatively new news.
sentences.zh: 它类似于我们之前在节目中讨论过的 Arduino 和其他类似设备。

sentences.en: So, so there's this thing you keep singing around the internet.
sentences.zh: 我听说你已经独立发现了这个，对吧？

sentences.en: First, I thought it was a dessert, raspberry pie.
sentences.zh: 你一直在关注这些，甚至还在等待名单上签了名。

sentences.en: Then I realized pie was spelled like the Greek letter and it turns out it's a embedded computer device that looks pretty cool.
sentences.zh: 是啊，确实。

sentences.en: A group of people got together and said, you know, that they want to make a embedded computer that's going to be $35 that runs Linux and see what people do.
sentences.zh: 我正在等待名单上等着抢购一个树莓派。

sentences.en: And it's similar to, we talked about on the show before the Arduino and other such devices.
sentences.zh: 它非常小巧。

sentences.en: And I heard you had, you had found this already independently, right?
sentences.zh: 我听说你已经独立发现了这个，对吧？

sentences.en: You had been, been looking at these and you even have your name on the wait liSt.
sentences.zh: 你一直在关注这些，甚至还在等待名单上留了名。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 没错，确实如此。

sentences.en: I'm on the wait list to grab a raspberry pie.
sentences.zh: 我正在排队等候购买树莓派。

sentences.en: It's relatively small.
sentences.zh: 它相对较小。

sentences.en: It's a embedded.
sentences.zh: 这是一种嵌入式设备。

sentences.en: So for people who aren't too familiar with embedded device, basically what that means is it's an entire computer on a single wafer.
sentences.zh: 所以对于那些不太熟悉嵌入式设备的人来说，这基本上意味着它是一整台电脑集成在单块晶圆上。

sentences.en: So on a single like sheet board.
sentences.zh: 就像是在一块单板上。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Single board.
sentences.zh: 单板。

sentences.en: So I'm trying to pull up the specs on how big it is.
sentences.zh: 我正在试着查一下它的具体尺寸。

sentences.en: I think it's like about twice the size of a credit card.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它大概只有信用卡的两倍大。

sentences.en: So like two credit cards, you can imagine like squarish, like stacked square wise.
sentences.zh: 所以就像两张信用卡，你可以想象成方形的，叠在一起的那种正方形。

sentences.en: And so it has many different things on it.
sentences.zh: 它上面有很多不同的组件。

sentences.en: So it has, you know, obviously a processor.
sentences.zh: 显然，它有一个处理器。

sentences.en: It has an SD card.
sentences.zh: 它有一个SD卡槽。

sentences.en: So you can pop an SD card, even a 32 gig SD card for storage.
sentences.zh: 你可以插一张SD卡，甚至是32GB的SD卡来存储数据。

sentences.en: There's a 25, there's a $35, which is $10 more than the base, base $25 model that has an ethernet port on it.
sentences.zh: 还有一款25美元和一款35美元的，后者比基础的25美元型号贵10美元，因为它带有一个以太网接口。

sentences.en: But other than that, it still has USB, has HDMI out.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，它依然有USB接口和HDMI输出接口。

sentences.en: I think it even has RCA out and stereo out.
sentences.zh: 我想它甚至还有RCA输出和立体声输出。

sentences.en: So you can imagine you're plugging one of these here into your television.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想象一下，把这东西插到你的电视机上。

sentences.en: You could, it has a GPIO for people who aren't familiar with that.
sentences.zh: 你可以这么做，它还有GPIO接口，对于不熟悉的人来说。

sentences.en: That's basically a way to...
sentences.zh: 这基本上是一种……

sentences.en: General purpose input and output.
sentences.zh: 通用输入输出接口。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: It's basically a way to talk to different things.
sentences.zh: 它基本上是一种与不同设备进行通信的方式。

sentences.en: If you have, excuse me, if you have little motors, so you want to make say a robot car or
sentences.zh: 如果你有，抱歉，如果你有一些小电机，比如你想做一个机器人小车或者

sentences.en: something like that, you could totally use a GPIO interface to talk to those stepper motors or talk to those, you know, brushless motors if you're making an airplane or whatever.
sentences.zh: 类似的东西，你完全可以使用GPIO接口来控制那些步进电机，或者如果你在做飞机模型之类的，用来控制无刷电机。

sentences.en: So you can do all sorts of really fun stuff with it.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以用它做各种非常有趣的事情。

sentences.en: Do you have any ideas of what you would do if you got one?
sentences.zh: 你有想过如果你有一个会拿它做什么吗？

sentences.en: These are so, there's so many cool things.
sentences.zh: 有太多太酷的事情可以做了。

sentences.en: And actually with the baby, you know, you start thinking of, you know, you see stuff in the store and like, I can make something that does the same thing.
sentences.zh: 实际上有了宝宝之后，你会开始思考，你在店里看到一些东西，就会想：我也能做出同样功能的设备。

sentences.en: Or, you know, feeding the baby takes a long time, you know.
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道，喂宝宝真的很花时间。

sentences.en: So like, if you give the baby a bottle or whatever, and then they drink, but it takes a long time, they're not good at holding it themselves.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你给宝宝喂奶瓶什么的，他们喝起来很慢，而且他们自己还拿不稳。

sentences.en: I think I really should design something to hold this so that, you know, I can go do other stuff and basically try to be as lazy as possible.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我真的应该设计一个支架来固定奶瓶，这样我就能去干别的事，基本上就是尽可能地偷懒。

sentences.en: But yeah, so constantly I'm thinking of things like that.
sentences.zh: 但确实，我一直在想这类事情。

sentences.en: But I think that having HDMI is really useful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得拥有HDMI接口真的很有用。

sentences.en: That's something that is traditionally very, you know, and also RCA video, but just having video output built in and so cheap has a lot of things because we've talked about
sentences.zh: 这在传统上是非常……当然还有RCA视频接口，但能以如此低廉的价格内置视频输出功能，意义重大，因为我们之前谈到过，

sentences.en: before, it's very rewarding to program something and see it in video and pictures.
sentences.zh: 编程并能通过视频和图像看到结果是非常有成就感的。

sentences.en: And that's why I think part of what game programming is so, such a thing that people get introduced to programming through.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我认为游戏编程是人们入门编程的重要途径之一。

sentences.en: And the thing, this board being so cheap and having that video capability is very intriguing.
sentences.zh: 而这块板子如此便宜且具备视频功能，非常引人入胜。

sentences.en: And what can you display onto a TV?
sentences.zh: 你能在电视上显示什么呢？

sentences.en: Because everybody has TVs and it's understandable.
sentences.zh: 因为每个人都有电视，而且这很容易理解。

sentences.en: And your friends, you know, if you show a little motor that spins around, it's like, okay, or, well, look, I blinked this LED in Morse code.
sentences.zh: 如果你向朋友展示一个转动的小电机，他们可能会说“哦，好吧”，或者“看，我用摩斯密码闪烁了这个LED灯”。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Like nobody cares.
sentences.zh: 根本没人关心。

sentences.en: But if you like put something up on the TV and like people like, wow, this is awesome.
sentences.zh: 但如果你把东西显示在电视上，人们就会说“哇，这太棒了”。

sentences.en: Like, how did you do this?
sentences.zh: “你是怎么做到的？”

sentences.en: So that's really intriguing to me.
sentences.zh: 所以这对我来说真的很有吸引力。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 没错，绝对是。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm, I personally, the first thing I'm going to do on it is get MAME, you know, multiple arcade machine emulator compiled on it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我个人打算在上面做的第一件事就是编译MAME，也就是多重街机模拟器。

sentences.en: I have no idea why I want to do that.
sentences.zh: 我也不知道为什么要这么做。

sentences.en: It already runs on my phone.
sentences.zh: 它已经在我的手机上运行了。

sentences.en: It's like, can it run Doom?
sentences.zh: 就像是，它能运行《毁灭战士》吗？

sentences.en: Everything else.
sentences.zh: 其他所有东西都一样。

sentences.en: It's not a proper computer until it runs Doom.
sentences.zh: 如果不运行《毁灭战士》，它就不算是一台真正的电脑。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是这样。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So I get a bunch of those stuff on it.
sentences.zh: 所以我会在上面装一堆那样的东西。

sentences.en: But I think long term, what I'd really want to do with it is either some kind of like social kind of like communication thing.
sentences.zh: 但从长远来看，我真正想用它做的是某种社交通讯类的东西。

sentences.en: So maybe a bunch of people at a party or something, you could have this as like a centerpiece and talk to it from your phones or something like that.
sentences.zh: 比如在聚会上，你可以把它作为中心设备，通过手机与它进行交互之类的。

sentences.en: That'd be cool.
sentences.zh: 那会很酷。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: And there's definitely, make a robot that can fit you drinks from the refrigerator or something like that.
sentences.zh: 而且绝对可以做一个机器人，能从冰箱里给你拿饮料之类的。

sentences.en: You and thousands of nerds before you have attempted such an endeavor.
sentences.zh: 你和在你之前的成千上万的极客们都尝试过这样的努力。

sentences.en: Will you be the first to completely succeed?
sentences.zh: 你会是第一个彻底成功的人吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it takes power.
sentences.zh: 是的，这需要电力。

sentences.en: I don't know if, it doesn't have a battery per se, but I'm sure people will add a module for that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，它本身没有电池，但我肯定人们会为它增加一个电池模块。

sentences.en: It also, it doesn't have any type of Wi-Fi like Bluetooth or, you know, or wireless.
sentences.zh: 它也没有任何Wi-Fi、蓝牙或无线功能。

sentences.en: But it does have a USB port and already some people are mass producing like really tiny little Wi-Fi nubs that plug into the USB port and add a little bit to the profile.
sentences.zh: 但它确实有一个USB接口，已经有人在批量生产那种插在USB接口上的超小型Wi-Fi适配器，只会增加一点点体积。

sentences.en: And Bluetooth ones as well, similarly small.
sentences.zh: 蓝牙适配器也一样，同样很小。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think they're looking at making a new version, like a Model C or something, which will have Wi-Fi.
sentences.zh: 而且我想他们正在考虑制作一个新版本，比如Model C之类的，它将内置Wi-Fi。

sentences.en: So look out for that in the future.
sentences.zh: 所以未来可以期待一下。

sentences.en: Yeah, it could be cool.
sentences.zh: 是的，那会很酷。

sentences.en: Something to keep your eye on.
sentences.zh: 值得关注一下。

sentences.en: And so the article that brought this up for the news is not only is this cool, but they've had issues again.
sentences.zh: 所以这篇新闻文章提到的不仅是它很酷，而且他们又遇到了问题。

sentences.en: We never really talked about it here, but a lot of hardware manufacturers have this.
sentences.zh: 我们之前没在这里讨论过，但很多硬件制造商都有这个问题。

sentences.en: It's very difficult to actually build something, unlike software, which you just kind of release it.
sentences.zh: 制造硬件真的很难，不像软件，你发布了就行。

sentences.en: And it's still very hard to get rid of all the bugs.
sentences.zh: 虽然软件也很难彻底消除所有Bug。

sentences.en: But with hardware, not only do you have the issue with the bugs, but sourcing the parts, getting the parts installed correctly, making sure you have the right parts.
sentences.zh: 但对于硬件，你不仅要面对Bug问题，还要采购零件、确保零件安装正确、确保零件型号无误。

sentences.en: Somebody could send you a batch.
sentences.zh: 别人可能会给你发来一批货。

sentences.en: You know, I was reading the other day about somebody was trying to make a hardware kit and they got wrong LEDs.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我前几天读到有人试图制作一个硬件套件，结果他们收到了错误的LED灯。

sentences.en: And it happened they were counterfeit LEDs.
sentences.zh: 而且碰巧那些是假冒的LED灯。

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And it causes all sorts of implications.
sentences.zh: 这会引发各种各样的连锁反应。

sentences.en: So they were going through some troubles with having wrong Ethernet port parts.
sentences.zh: 所以他们当时正因为以太网接口零件错误而陷入困境。

sentences.en: Yeah, I saw that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我看到了。

sentences.en: They didn't have, I guess, proper shielding on the Ethernet, but supposedly it's been fixed now.
sentences.zh: 我猜他们当时以太网接口的屏蔽层做得不够好，但据说现在已经修复了。

sentences.en: So that's good news.
sentences.zh: 那是个好消息。

sentences.en: And I honestly think that, you know, save yourself the $10 and buy the one that doesn't have Ethernet and put a Wi-Fi thing on it.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我觉得你可以省下那10美元，买那个没有以太网接口的版本，然后自己加个Wi-Fi适配器。

sentences.en: Yeah, especially if you wait a little bit and see which Wi-Fi is the best supported one.
sentences.zh: 是的，特别是如果你等一等，看看哪种Wi-Fi适配器的兼容性最好。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's true.
sentences.zh: 没错，确实如此。

sentences.en: They're actually, if you go to the FAQ, there's a section on Wi-Fi and it has a list of, like, ones they recommend.
sentences.zh: 实际上，如果你去查看常见问题解答，里面有一个关于Wi-Fi的部分，列出了他们推荐的型号。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: That's a really important point.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常重要的点。

sentences.en: So I've done a lot of this kind of stuff before.
sentences.zh: 所以我以前做过很多这类事情。

sentences.en: I've used gumsticks.
sentences.zh: 我用过Gumstix。

sentences.en: Patrick's done a lot with Arduino.
sentences.zh: Patrick用Arduino做过很多东西。

sentences.en: And, you know, a lot of these embedded operating systems, they don't support, you know, a wide range of hardware.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，很多嵌入式操作系统并不支持广泛的硬件。

sentences.en: So you might go to Best Buy, let's say, and buy USB Wi-Fi and it just won't work.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会去百思买买一个USB Wi-Fi适配器，结果它根本用不了。

sentences.en: And it's because so much on the software level just hasn't been implemented for this OS.
sentences.zh: 这是因为在软件层面，很多驱动程序还没有针对这个操作系统实现。

sentences.en: Well, and often it's proprietary.
sentences.zh: 而且通常它们是专有的。

sentences.en: So whoever makes that particular stick D-Link or whatever won't release a Linux driver for it or will release it in such a way that it's very hard to get that to work on other platforms or other devices.
sentences.zh: 所以制造那个特定适配器的厂商，比如D-Link之类的，不会发布Linux驱动，或者发布的方式导致很难在其他平台或设备上运行。

sentences.en: Yeah, so keep in mind that embedded devices run what's called ARM.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以要记住嵌入式设备运行的是所谓的ARM架构。

sentences.en: Most of them run ARM.
sentences.zh: 它们大多数运行ARM。

sentences.en: And long story short is ARM is just a different type of processor than what you have on your desktop.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，ARM是一种与你台式机上完全不同的处理器。

sentences.en: So the instructions are different.
sentences.zh: 所以指令集是不同的。

sentences.en: For example, like, if you want to move data from one register to another, just a way to describe that action in ARM is different.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你想把数据从一个寄存器移动到另一个寄存器，在ARM中描述该动作的方式是不同的。

sentences.en: And the set of instructions is different.
sentences.zh: 而且指令集本身也不同。

sentences.en: So because of that, you know, even if you have some USB, you know, Wi-Fi adapter that works in Ubuntu, you know, on your desktop,
sentences.zh: 所以正因如此，即使你有一个在Ubuntu桌面版上能用的USB Wi-Fi适配器，

sentences.en: doesn't necessarily mean that it'll work on these embedded systems for that reason.
sentences.zh: 也不一定意味着它能在这些嵌入式系统上工作。

sentences.en: And talk about confusing consumers.
sentences.zh: 这简直是在把消费者搞糊涂。

sentences.en: Yeah, so embedded systems require a little bit of, you know, thinking beforehand.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以嵌入式系统需要提前做一点思考。

sentences.en: But the nice thing, the whole goal of this Raspberry Pi is that up until now, even Arduino was close to $100, right?
sentences.zh: 但好的一点是，Raspberry Pi的初衷就是，直到现在，即使是Arduino也要接近100美元，对吧？

sentences.en: So you can get ones that are fairly cheap, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以买到一些相当便宜的，是的。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧。

sentences.en: The thing is that they don't have, they're not accomplishing the same kind of task.
sentences.zh: 问题是它们完成的任务类型不同。

sentences.en: And they've been around for a lot longer.
sentences.zh: 而且它们已经存在很久了。

sentences.en: Gotcha, gotcha.
sentences.zh: 明白了，明白了。

sentences.en: Yeah, because I know the gumsticks, which is similar specs to this, was close to $600.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为我知道规格与此类似的Gumstix曾经要价接近600美元。

sentences.en: So, you know, this being $35, it opens this technology up to a whole new audience.
sentences.zh: 所以，这东西只要35美元，就向全新的受众群体开放了这项技术。

sentences.en: And so I think that people will be much more educated about embedded systems moving forward.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为人们在未来会对嵌入式系统有更多的了解。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it's definitely a useful skill talking about, you know, people interested in skills that transfer to the real world.
sentences.zh: 是的，这绝对是一项有用的技能，谈到人们对那些能应用到现实世界的技能感兴趣时。

sentences.en: I mean, there are many, many, many, many, many companies out there doing stuff with embedded computing platforms, systems,
sentences.zh: 我是说，外面有非常非常多的公司在使用嵌入式计算平台和系统，

sentences.en: and learning how to program in a limited resource environment that the systems represent is a very transferable skill.
sentences.zh: 学习如何在这些系统所代表的资源受限环境中进行编程，是一项非常可迁移的技能。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: So talking about making a robot.
sentences.zh: 那么，谈谈制作机器人吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, so we're going to talk now about California being the second state to allow autonomous cars.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们现在来谈谈加利福尼亚州成为第二个允许自动驾驶汽车上路的州。

sentences.en: So what was the first one?
sentences.zh: 那么第一个是哪个州？

sentences.en: So the first state was Nevada.
sentences.zh: 第一个州是内华达州。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Yeah, they passed the bill a few months ago.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们几个月前通过了这项法案。

sentences.en: It wasn't that long ago.
sentences.zh: 没过多久。

sentences.en: So up until then, people had been sort of testing autonomous cars in very controlled environments.
sentences.zh: 所以在那之前，人们一直在受控环境中测试自动驾驶汽车。

sentences.en: Then Nevada passed a law not too long ago saying that as long as somebody is in the car, you can have a machine or have a computer driving the car.
sentences.zh: 然后内华达州不久前通过了一项法律，规定只要车里有人，就可以让机器或电脑驾驶汽车。

sentences.en: But there had to be a person there to sort of supervise and take control.
sentences.zh: 但必须有一个人在场进行监督并随时接管控制权。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I thought a lot about this.
sentences.zh: 是的，我对此思考了很多。

sentences.en: In addition to censorship for kids, no.
sentences.zh: 除了针对儿童的审查制度之外，不。

sentences.en: And so I think about autonomous cars because I really want one.
sentences.zh: 我经常思考自动驾驶汽车，因为我真的很想要一辆。

sentences.en: Every day when I commute to work, I think, I want that autonomous car.
sentences.zh: 每天通勤上班时，我都在想：我想要那辆自动驾驶汽车。

sentences.en: Where is it?
sentences.zh: 它在哪儿呢？

sentences.en: When is it coming?
sentences.zh: 它什么时候才能到来？

sentences.en: The other week we drove to LA, which is, we both don't know, the drive from Northern California to LA is about, what, six hours, seven hours, something like that.
sentences.zh: 上周我们开车去洛杉矶，我们都知道，从北加州开车到洛杉矶大约需要，嗯，六七个小时，差不多这样。

sentences.en: So it's a long drive.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一段很长的车程。

sentences.en: And the whole time I was thinking, God, if I had an autonomous car, like all four of the seats could just face the middle and we could be playing Agricola or Power Grid right now.
sentences.zh: 全程我都在想，天哪，如果我有一辆自动驾驶汽车，四个座位都可以面向中间，我们现在就能玩《农场主》或《电力公司》了。

sentences.en: Board games.
sentences.zh: 桌游。

sentences.en: Yeah, we could totally be board gaming for seven hours.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们完全可以玩七个小时的桌游。

sentences.en: This is like, this is time that is so valuable.
sentences.zh: 这简直是太宝贵的时间了。

sentences.en: Last time.
sentences.zh: 最后的时间。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I think about this, I just, it's going to be one of those things that I think is going to, even once the technology enables it, it's still not going to be here.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直在想，我觉得这会是那种即使技术已经成熟，它依然不会很快普及的事情。

sentences.en: And it's just going to be one of those things that's kind of, because it's going to be so hard.
sentences.zh: 这只会是那种因为难度极大而迟迟无法实现的事情。

sentences.en: Who do you blame when an accident happens?
sentences.zh: 发生事故时，你该责怪谁呢？

sentences.en: You know, the officer shows up and who does he write the ticket to?
sentences.zh: 你知道，警察赶到现场后，他会给谁开罚单？

sentences.en: You know, who do the, what do the insurance companies do?
sentences.zh: 你知道，保险公司又会怎么做？

sentences.en: You know, how do they price that in to insure cars that are autonomous?
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们会如何定价来为自动驾驶汽车承保？

sentences.en: You know, all these situations are even, I know there was one case where an autonomous car was driving and got rear-ended.
sentences.zh: 你知道，所有这些情况都很……我知道有个案例，一辆自动驾驶汽车在行驶时被追尾了。

sentences.en: Well, I don't think the autonomy was on at the time, but even if it did, like what happens if it's not even the fault of the autonomous car?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得当时自动驾驶功能应该没开，但就算开了，如果根本不是自动驾驶汽车的错，那会怎么样？

sentences.en: The first thing that's going to happen is, despite how much does engineers, it doesn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 首先会发生的事情是，不管工程师怎么说，这在逻辑上都说不通。

sentences.en: The first time somebody rear-ends a car that's autonomous, and it was 100% their fault, but they have a really good lawyer.
sentences.zh: 当有人第一次追尾了一辆自动驾驶汽车，而且百分之百是他们的错，但他们又请了个非常厉害的律师。

sentences.en: That lawyer is going to bring a lawsuit against the other person saying that they want all the source code for the autonomous car.
sentences.zh: 那个律师就会对另一方提起诉讼，声称他们想要自动驾驶汽车的所有源代码。

sentences.en: They want it reviewed.
sentences.zh: 他们想要审查这些代码。

sentences.en: They think it's his fault that it applied the brakes too suddenly, faster than what a human could have, or any of these things.
sentences.zh: 他们认为是因为汽车刹车太突然，比人类反应更快，或者诸如此类的问题，才导致了事故。

sentences.en: And basically, in a fight to try to get overturned, and then it's going to get caught up in a legal quagmire for the foreseeable future.
sentences.zh: 基本上，为了推翻判决，这件事在可预见的未来会陷入法律泥潭。

sentences.en: Yeah, the thing I'm worried about too is, or just interested I guess more is a better word, is are people going to be able to game the autonomous car?
sentences.zh: 是啊，我担心的，或者说更感兴趣的是，人们以后会不会钻自动驾驶汽车的空子？

sentences.en: So, let's say half the cars on the road are autonomous, and you need to get to work, and you're really in a hurry.
sentences.zh: 假设路上有一半的车是自动驾驶的，而你需要赶去上班，而且非常着急。

sentences.en: Like, you're late for work.
sentences.zh: 比如，你上班要迟到了。

sentences.en: If you turn off the autonomous mode, can you like somehow game the AI that's driving the other cars?
sentences.zh: 如果你关掉自动驾驶模式，能不能通过某种方式去“戏弄”那些正在驾驶其他车辆的人工智能？

sentences.en: So, if you flash your lights three times, and you wiggle your car, it thinks you're drunk, and so it gets out of the way.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你闪三下车灯，再晃动一下车身，它会以为你喝醉了，然后就会避开你。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，正是这样。

sentences.en: And you can just speed past it.
sentences.zh: 然后你就可以直接加速超过去了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, I think there's almost going to be an arms race between the autonomous cars and the human drivers who want to get past them.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，自动驾驶汽车和那些想超车的驾驶员之间，几乎会展开一场军备竞赛。

sentences.en: Well, I think early, the high occupancy lanes and stuff like this will be enabled for autonomous cars because they can drive so much closer.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得在早期，高乘载车道之类的设施会向自动驾驶汽车开放，因为它们可以靠得非常近行驶。

sentences.en: And so, they'll be able to say, like, this is an autonomous car, and they'll have special designated lanes for them.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们会说，这是一辆自动驾驶汽车，并为它们设立专门的车道。

sentences.en: So, that it's different.
sentences.zh: 这样就不同了。

sentences.en: Because that is going to be the most difficult time.
sentences.zh: 因为那将是最困难的时期。

sentences.en: If we switch completely to an infrastructure that supported autonomous cars, and there were only autonomous cars on the road, it would be very simple, actually.
sentences.zh: 如果我们完全切换到支持自动驾驶汽车的基础设施，路上只有自动驾驶汽车，那其实会非常简单。

sentences.en: Or, when you get onto a freeway, it's required that you have autonomy enabled, and you're not allowed to disable it while you're on the freeway.
sentences.zh: 或者，当你进入高速公路时，要求必须开启自动驾驶，并且在高速公路上不允许关闭它。

sentences.en: It would be very easy.
sentences.zh: 那样会非常容易。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: But between now and then, what do you do?
sentences.zh: 但在那之前，你该怎么办？

sentences.en: Like, you're going to have, in the beginning, you know, very few cars which are autonomous, then slowly more and more and more.
sentences.zh: 比如，起初你可能只有极少数自动驾驶汽车，然后慢慢地越来越多。

sentences.en: And through each of these phases, autonomous cars have to behave differently.
sentences.zh: 在每一个阶段，自动驾驶汽车的行为方式都必须有所不同。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: I just, I think that, you know, in some senses, though, I think that, I just wonder if people will be more or less stressed.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，在某种意义上，我很好奇人们会变得更轻松还是更焦虑。

sentences.en: Because, you know, they'll be stressed because they could go faster if they were driving it themselves.
sentences.zh: 因为，他们会感到焦虑，如果自己开车的话明明可以开得更快。

sentences.en: Part of the whole thing about the autonomous car is that it'll probably do close to the speed limit.
sentences.zh: 自动驾驶汽车的一个特点是，它大概只会以接近限速的速度行驶。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm sure the autonomous AI won't.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我敢肯定自动驾驶人工智能不会超速。

sentences.en: Well, but that speed limit, in theory, will go up.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但理论上限速会提高。

sentences.en: Because it doesn't even make sense anymore.
sentences.zh: 因为现在的限速已经没有意义了。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's true.
sentences.zh: 是的，那倒是真的。

sentences.en: Because the car will just know what the safest speed it can drive at based on everything.
sentences.zh: 因为汽车会根据各种情况，自动判断出它能行驶的最安全速度。

sentences.en: I wonder if you'll be able to customize it.
sentences.zh: 我在想你是否能对它进行自定义设置。

sentences.en: I wonder if there'll be autonomous car hackers.
sentences.zh: 我在想会不会出现自动驾驶汽车黑客。

sentences.en: So, I mean, in the state of California, for those of you who don't know, they actually have a thing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在加利福尼亚州，对于那些不知道的人，他们确实有这么个规定。

sentences.en: So, if you want to get your car, basically, you know, registered to drive, they inspect it.
sentences.zh: 如果你想让你的车注册上路，他们会进行检查。

sentences.en: And they look for, you know, modifications that aren't approved that make it emit too much pollution.
sentences.zh: 他们会查看是否有未经批准的改装导致排放超标。

sentences.en: They test it to see how much pollution it emits, all these kind of things.
sentences.zh: 他们会测试它的排放量，以及所有这类东西。

sentences.en: There will be a check, you know, checksum on your, you know, autonomous software.
sentences.zh: 以后会对你的自动驾驶软件进行校验和检查。

sentences.en: And if the checksum for your software doesn't check out, they know you modified it.
sentences.zh: 如果你的软件校验和对不上，他们就知道你改装过它。

sentences.en: And they're going to, you know, write you a ticket.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就会给你开罚单。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Or something like that.
sentences.zh: 或者类似的事情。

sentences.en: So, you know, also, I recommend you get yourself on the Raspberry Pi waiting list, as I'm on,
sentences.zh: 所以，我也建议你把自己加入到树莓派的等待名单里，就像我一样，

sentences.en: so that you can write your autonomous car hacker when both of these things are made available.
sentences.zh: 这样当这两样东西都上市时，你就可以去写你的自动驾驶汽车黑客程序了。

sentences.en: And if you want to learn how to write an autonomous car, I have another news link for you.
sentences.zh: 如果你想学习如何编写自动驾驶汽车程序，我还有另一个新闻链接给你。

sentences.en: Stanford is just starting to roll out some new online courses.
sentences.zh: 斯坦福大学刚刚开始推出一些新的在线课程。

sentences.en: So, last semester, quarter, you know, I guess last year at some point, Stanford did the first of these, which was machine learning.
sentences.zh: 上个学期，或者说去年某个时候，斯坦福大学推出了第一门课程，是关于机器学习的。

sentences.en: And I think they had another one as well.
sentences.zh: 我想他们还有另一门课。

sentences.en: And it's by a really reputable, I'm going to mess up the name, Andrew Ning?
sentences.zh: 是由一位非常有名的教授讲授的，名字我可能会念错，是Andrew Ning吗？

sentences.en: Andrew Ning.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·宁。

sentences.en: Ning, okay.
sentences.zh: Ng，好的。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's like a, I guess a hidden eye, not a silent eye, but the opposite.
sentences.zh: 是的，里面有个隐藏的i，不是不发音的i，而是相反的情况。

sentences.en: There's a hidden eye.
sentences.zh: 有个隐藏的i。

sentences.en: So, it's Andrew NG.
sentences.zh: 所以是Andrew Ng。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he is a professor at Stanford, and he taught this machine learning class to the internet for free.
sentences.zh: 他是斯坦福大学的教授，他免费在网上教授这门机器学习课程。

sentences.en: And it's structured very much like a class that you would take out of college, you know, with exams and everything.
sentences.zh: 它的结构非常像你在大学里上的课，有考试等等。

sentences.en: But it's all automated and tests and a schedule for you to go through and forums for you to talk on.
sentences.zh: 但一切都是自动化的，有测试，有学习进度表，还有供你交流的论坛。

sentences.en: And you get a certificate upon completion.
sentences.zh: 完成课程后你还能获得证书。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: So, I started in it, and then I got busy and didn't end up finishing it.
sentences.zh: 我开始学了，但后来太忙，最后没学完。

sentences.en: And so, I actually thought what happened.
sentences.zh: 所以我其实一直在想发生了什么。

sentences.en: But this year, they're rolling out a lot more of those courses.
sentences.zh: 但今年，他们正在推出更多这样的课程。

sentences.en: So, I'm here on the list, and some of them include the machine learning one again, software as a service.
sentences.zh: 我已经在名单上了，其中一些包括再次开设的机器学习课程，还有软件即服务。

sentences.en: This is a buzzword starting to lose some of its shine, but still important.
sentences.zh: 这是一个开始失去光环的流行词，但仍然很重要。

sentences.en: Natural language processing.
sentences.zh: 自然语言处理。

sentences.en: So, getting computers to work with, you know, the spoken and the written word.
sentences.zh: 也就是让计算机处理口语和书面语。

sentences.en: Cryptography, design and analysis of algorithms, computer vision.
sentences.zh: 密码学、算法设计与分析、计算机视觉。

sentences.en: I mean, these are the kinds of things nerds really like.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这些都是书呆子们真正喜欢的东西。

sentences.en: I mean, sorry, we really like.
sentences.zh: 我是说，抱歉，是我们真正喜欢的东西。

sentences.en: And then, they have a few more which are getting ready to come out that, you know, are going to be out this year.
sentences.zh: 他们还有一些准备推出的课程，今年就会上线。

sentences.en: Probabilistic graphical models.
sentences.zh: 概率图模型。

sentences.en: So, this is how Xbox's true skill works on a system similar to this.
sentences.zh: 这就是Xbox的TrueSkill系统运作的原理，基于类似的系统。

sentences.en: Game theory, human-computer interaction, computer science 101.
sentences.zh: 博弈论、人机交互、计算机科学101。

sentences.en: Maybe we should have all the parents who allow their kids on the internet to take computer science 101.
sentences.zh: 也许我们应该让所有允许孩子上网的家长都去修一下计算机科学101。

sentences.en: Maybe that'll, no, okay, that's a bad idea.
sentences.zh: 也许那样会……不，好吧，那是个馊主意。

sentences.en: Information theory and anatomy.
sentences.zh: 信息论和解剖学。

sentences.en: Really, anatomy?
sentences.zh: 真的吗，解剖学？

sentences.en: Anatomy.
sentences.zh: 解剖学。

sentences.en: And I don't think it's anatomy of a computer.
sentences.zh: 我不觉得是计算机解剖学。

sentences.en: I was going to say, is it like von Neumann anatomy?
sentences.zh: 我正想说，是冯·诺依曼架构之类的吗？

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: Computer security and making green buildings.
sentences.zh: 计算机安全和绿色建筑。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: So, they're starting to branch out, but most of these are still applicable to computer people.
sentences.zh: 所以他们开始涉足其他领域，但大多数课程仍然适用于计算机专业人士。

sentences.en: And so,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: I would recommend if you are not a person who's enrolled in college or graduated with a computer science degree or not already a programmer and you want to start learning some of those things and getting involved,
sentences.zh: 如果你不是在校大学生，没有计算机科学学位，也不是程序员，但你想开始学习这些知识并参与其中，

sentences.en: this is an excellent, completely free resource for you to use.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常棒的、完全免费的资源，供你使用。

sentences.en: And I think, so, we've had discussions about this at work, about, you know, having a child and what is the university system going to be like when our children, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想，我们在工作中讨论过这个问题，关于生孩子，以及当我们的孩子到了上大学的年龄时，大学体系会是什么样？

sentences.en: become college age?
sentences.zh: 他们到了上大学的年龄。

sentences.en: Will colleges as they stand today exist?
sentences.zh: 现在的大学还会存在吗？

sentences.en: Will it be completely online?
sentences.zh: 会完全变成在线教育吗？

sentences.en: Will it be a hybrid?
sentences.zh: 会是混合模式吗？

sentences.en: What will happen?
sentences.zh: 会发生什么？

sentences.en: It's getting so expensive to go to college now.
sentences.zh: 现在上大学变得越来越贵了。

sentences.en: I don't think it's sustainable that something is going to change.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这种模式能持续下去，肯定会有所改变。

sentences.en: Something will break.
sentences.zh: 总会有什么东西会崩溃。

sentences.en: And what's it going to be like?
sentences.zh: 那会是什么样呢？

sentences.en: And what does that mean for putting away money?
sentences.zh: 这对存钱意味着什么？

sentences.en: So, it's so big today because college is so expensive for parents to put away money for their kids to go to college.
sentences.zh: 现在这事儿之所以这么大，是因为大学学费太贵，家长们得为孩子上大学存钱。

sentences.en: And if college is going to be completely different in, you know, 18 years, what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 如果18年后大学完全变了样，那意味着什么？

sentences.en: How do you plan for that?
sentences.zh: 你该如何为此做计划？

sentences.en: What should you teach your children now about learning online so that they can be prepared to be in classrooms where there's no physical teacher?
sentences.zh: 你现在应该教孩子什么关于在线学习的知识，让他们为在没有实体老师的教室里上课做好准备？

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: I mean, I know it took several of my courses on, I think UCF called it feeds,
sentences.zh: 我是说，我知道我修过几门课，我想UCF称之为Feeds，

sentences.en: but I'm sure there's something similar at UF where you take the course online and there's essentially a camera set up in the classroom and things like that.
sentences.zh: 但我肯定UF也有类似的东西，你在网上上课，教室里基本上架设了一台摄像机之类的。

sentences.en: But then you showed up for the exaMs.
sentences.zh: 但考试时你得亲自到场。

sentences.en: So, that was starting to approach, you know, totally online.
sentences.zh: 所以那开始接近完全在线了。

sentences.en: But now I know several courses at many universities are done completely online.
sentences.zh: 但现在我知道许多大学的很多课程都是完全在线完成的。

sentences.en: It's a different skill set, though, because there's no, when you have class, there's some, even if you go,
sentences.zh: 不过这需要不同的技能，因为当你上课时，即使你去上课，

sentences.en: depending on your college and what class and your major and your professor's niceness or not, you know,
sentences.zh: 取决于你的大学、课程、专业以及教授是否和蔼，你知道，

sentences.en: there's some amount of peer pressure and obligation to show up to class and listen to them talk when they're talking.
sentences.zh: 总会有一定的同伴压力和义务去上课，并在他们讲课时听讲。

sentences.en: And that keeps you on schedule.
sentences.zh: 这能让你保持进度。

sentences.en: If it's on video, you can always just watch it tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 如果是视频课程，你总可以明天再看。

sentences.en: But if you keep just, I'm going to watch it tomorrow, you never watch it.
sentences.zh: 但如果你一直拖着说“我明天再看”，你就永远不会看了。

sentences.en: And then what happens when you have to show up and take the test?
sentences.zh: 然后当你必须去参加考试时会发生什么？

sentences.en: And, you know, there's a level of self-motivation that you have to enforce on yourself there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这需要一种你必须强加给自己的自我激励水平。

sentences.zh: Google Web Toolkit 的理念是，你用 Java 写代码，然后这个 Google Web

sentences.en: So Dart is an attempt to sort of create a brand new language that can give you kind of like the flexibility and the rapid prototyping that you need to, you know, make things quick

sentences.zh: 但另一方面，你又想在浏览器中编写大型程序。

sentences.en: And so Dart is a way to sort of balance both of these.

sentences.zh: 所以你可以认为 Frog 之于 Dart，就像 Google Web Toolkit 之于 Java。

sentences.en: They both have classes, interfaces, this whole thing.

sentences.en: One nice thing about Dart is that it also sort of gives you some of the features of JavaScript if you want.
sentences.zh: Dart 的一个好处是，如果你需要，它也能为你提供一些 JavaScript 的特性。

sentences.en: So, for example, in Dart, you can say int x equals 3, and now x has that 3 in it.
sentences.zh: 例如，在 Dart 中，你可以写 int x = 3，现在 x 里就有 3 了。

sentences.en: If you later say x equals Patrick, it'll say an error.

sentences.zh: 它会说 x 是个整数，你试图把它设为 Patrick，这行不通。

sentences.en: And so these are the kind of things that you want as a developer.
sentences.zh: 这些就是你作为开发者想要的东西。

sentences.en: You want it to give you an error up front.
sentences.zh: 你希望它能提前报错。

sentences.zh: 或许这样吧，我来讲协程，你来讲多进程。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: So coroutines are having multiple threads in a single process.
sentences.zh: 协程是指在单个进程中拥有多个线程。

sentences.en: So you might say to yourself, like, why would I want to do this, right?
sentences.zh: 你可能会问自己，为什么要这么做呢，对吧？

sentences.en: And the answer is, let's say you're waiting for someone to type a key on the keyboard.
sentences.zh: 答案是，假设你正在等待用户在键盘上输入按键。

sentences.en: But at the same time, you were, you know, constantly updating your GUI.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，你又需要不断地更新图形用户界面（GUI）。

sentences.en: Maybe there's some, like, graphic animation going on in the background, but at the same time, you want someone to be able to type in, or you want someone to click a button to
sentences.zh: 也许后台正在运行某种图形动画，但你同时又希望用户能够输入内容，或者点击按钮来

sentences.en: stop the animation, right?
sentences.zh: 停止动画，对吧？

sentences.en: So you need to be able to do both of these things at the same time.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要能够同时处理这两件事。

sentences.en: You don't want to have just one loop that says, you know, run a little bit of the animation, and then check to see if Patrick pressed the key, and then run a little bit and go back
sentences.zh: 你肯定不想只用一个循环，一会儿运行一小段动画，一会儿检查 Patrick 是否按了键，然后再运行一小段，来回

sentences.en: and forth, because this makes the code really confusing.
sentences.zh: 切换，因为这会让代码变得非常混乱。

sentences.en: What you really want is to have two different things running at the same time, one that's waiting for an input, and the other that's running the animation.
sentences.zh: 你真正想要的是同时运行两个不同的任务，一个负责等待输入，另一个负责运行动画。

sentences.en: So you could do this in multi-processing, where you have, you know, two different threads on your operating system that are both doing different things.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过多进程来实现，即在操作系统中有两个不同的线程，它们各自执行不同的任务。

sentences.en: But this causes a lot of overhead.
sentences.zh: 但这会带来很大的开销。

sentences.en: Anytime you create another process, you have to go to the operating system and say, hey, operating
sentences.zh: 每当你创建一个新进程，你都必须向操作系统请求，嘿，操作

sentences.en: system, I need, you know, I need another space to run, to run some executor, to execute some code.
sentences.zh: 系统，我需要，你知道的，我需要另一个空间来运行，运行某个执行器，去执行一些代码。

sentences.en: And it has to go and fetch that for you.
sentences.zh: 然后它必须去为你获取这些资源。

sentences.en: And that's a little time consuming.
sentences.zh: 这比较耗时。

sentences.en: Also, as we mentioned, Dart can be compiled to JavaScript, and JavaScript doesn't support multi-processing.
sentences.zh: 另外，正如我们提到的，Dart 可以编译成 JavaScript，而 JavaScript 不支持多进程。

sentences.en: So, you know, there's no way to do that in JavaScript.
sentences.zh: 所以，在 JavaScript 中是没法那样做的。

sentences.en: So, Dart has this idea of what Dart calls a light isolate.
sentences.zh: 因此，Dart 有一个概念，Dart 称之为“轻量级隔离区”（light isolate）。

sentences.en: And this allows you to do coroutines, where you have many different threads, but they're all sharing a slice of the same process.
sentences.zh: 这允许你使用协程，即拥有多个不同的线程，但它们共享同一个进程的资源。

sentences.en: So the process, basically, the process will do sort of what I was describing earlier, where it'll play a little bit of animation and then listen for a keystroke.
sentences.zh: 所以这个进程，基本上会做我刚才描述的那种事，即播放一小段动画，然后监听键盘输入。

sentences.en: But from a code perspective, you're writing code as if you have two things going at the same time.
sentences.zh: 但从代码角度来看，你编写代码的方式就像是有两个任务在同时运行一样。

sentences.en: And the multi-threaded is simulated.
sentences.zh: 而且这种多线程是模拟出来的。

sentences.en: So this is different than multi-processing, which Patrick talked about.
sentences.zh: 所以这与 Patrick 提到的多进程不同。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So multi-processing, you know, Jason talked about threads sharing a process.
sentences.zh: 关于多进程，Jason 刚才谈到了线程共享进程。

sentences.en: And the process is kind of what the operating system deals in.
sentences.zh: 进程是操作系统处理的基本单位。

sentences.en: And the operating system schedules processes for the processors to run.
sentences.zh: 操作系统负责调度进程给处理器去运行。

sentences.en: And there's overhead there, such as, like, things that include, like, the stack.
sentences.zh: 这其中存在开销，比如包含栈空间之类的东西。

sentences.en: And when you make a thread inside a process, you kind of have to emulate that or eliminate it.
sentences.zh: 当你在一个进程内创建一个线程时，你必须模拟或消除这种开销。

sentences.en: And there's all sorts of ways of handling that based on, you know, what you're trying to accomplish.
sentences.zh: 根据你想要实现的目标，有各种各样的方法来处理这个问题。

sentences.en: But multi-processing, in theory, allows you, if you have a whole process and you have multiple processors, the operating system can schedule one process to run on one and
sentences.zh: 但从理论上讲，如果你有一个完整的进程，并且有多个处理器，操作系统可以将一个进程调度到一个处理器上运行，

sentences.en: one process to run on the other.
sentences.zh: 而将另一个进程调度到另一个处理器上运行。

sentences.en: And give yourself true multiple things running at the same time versus the CPU just slicing very finely, alternating between two different threads.
sentences.zh: 这样你就能真正实现多任务同时运行，而不是让 CPU 在两个不同的线程之间进行极其细微的切换。

sentences.en: So as a programmer, if the things you're doing aren't particularly intensive, like, you know, draw some animation, you know, check the keyboard.
sentences.zh: 所以作为程序员，如果你所做的事情不是特别密集，比如，画一些动画，检查一下键盘。

sentences.en: Draw some animation, check the keyboard.
sentences.zh: 画一些动画，检查一下键盘。

sentences.en: If neither of those turn out to be, you know, intensive, or in this case, checking the keyboard
sentences.zh: 如果这两者都不是密集的，或者在这种情况下，检查键盘

sentences.en: most of the time you're just doing nothing, then you can share one process on one processor and it's not a big deal.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候你只是在空转，那么你可以在一个处理器上共享一个进程，这没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: But if you want to, you know, render the graphics and also compute a path for some entity, if
sentences.zh: 但如果你想渲染图形，同时还要为某个实体计算路径，如果你在做游戏编程，

sentences.en: you're doing, like, you know, game programming and you want to have AI, those two things are very meaty, intensive things.
sentences.zh: 并且想要实现人工智能，这两件事都是非常繁重、密集的任务。

sentences.en: And if you put them in two threads inside of a single process, it makes it harder for the operating system to know what to do.
sentences.zh: 如果你把它们放在单个进程内的两个线程中，操作系统就很难知道该怎么处理。

sentences.en: If you put them in two separate processes, the operating system can say, oh, I'll put one on one processor and one on the other.
sentences.zh: 如果你把它们放在两个独立的进程中，操作系统就可以说，哦，我把一个放在一个处理器上，另一个放在另一个处理器上。

sentences.en: And then they can run at the same time.
sentences.zh: 然后它们就可以同时运行了。

sentences.en: And in theory, make your stuff go twice as faSt.
sentences.zh: 理论上，这能让你的程序运行速度翻倍。

sentences.en: There's lots of issues with that simplification, but that's what it means at a low level.
sentences.zh: 这种简化存在很多问题，但在底层就是这个意思。

sentences.en: But sometimes you don't need that.
sentences.zh: 但有时你并不需要那样做。

sentences.en: And there's overhead that's incurred from the processor standpoint, switching the process, having all this extra information that the operating system stores about it and moving
sentences.zh: 从处理器角度来看，切换进程会产生开销，操作系统需要存储所有这些额外信息，并根据运行的内容将它们移入移出处理器，

sentences.en: those in and out of the processor, depending on what's running, is something that you want to avoid if you don't need it.
sentences.zh: 如果你不需要的话，这是你想要避免的。

sentences.en: But sometimes you need it and it's worth it if it means you can get scheduled on two different processors at the same time.
sentences.zh: 但有时你需要它，如果这意味着你可以同时在两个不同的处理器上被调度，那么它是值得的。

sentences.en: Yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 没错，完全同意。

sentences.en: So the only other thing I guess I can mention on that is that the heavy isolates, you don't share any data, which, you know, as Patrick mentioned, because they're on two different,
sentences.zh: 关于这一点，我能想到的另一件事是，重量级隔离区（heavy isolates）不共享任何数据，正如 Patrick 所提到的，因为它们位于两个不同的

sentences.en: they're two different processes.
sentences.zh: 它们是两个不同的进程。

sentences.en: They can run on two different processes.
sentences.zh: 它们可以在两个不同的处理器上运行。

sentences.en: So you have to basically pass messages from one isolate or from the main thread to the isolates versus the light isolates, they can actually share data because they know that
sentences.zh: 所以你基本上必须从一个隔离区或主线程向隔离区传递消息，而轻量级隔离区则不同，它们实际上可以共享数据，因为它们知道

sentences.en: they don't have to be on the same processor.
sentences.zh: 它们不必在同一个处理器上运行。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，正是如此。

sentences.en: And then, oh man, we could do a whole episode about even, that's not language focused, but about the differences and all the different ways that CPUs handle multi-threading and
sentences.zh: 还有，天哪，我们甚至可以专门做一期节目，虽然不是针对语言本身的，而是关于 CPU 处理多线程和

sentences.en: multi-processing and different languages.
sentences.zh: 多进程以及不同语言的各种方式和差异。

sentences.en: And that's something that today is becoming more applicable than ever before because those processors stop getting faster and start getting more cores.
sentences.zh: 这是当今比以往任何时候都更适用的课题，因为处理器不再单纯追求速度，而是开始增加核心数量。

sentences.en: This is something that we have to start worrying about.
sentences.zh: 这是我们必须开始担心的问题。

sentences.en: How do we schedule efficiently 32 cores to do something on the computer?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何高效地调度 32 个核心来完成计算机上的任务？

sentences.en: And it's not always straightforward most of the time.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候这并不总是直截了当的。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: We should do, if we do Go as a language, we should do like a whole thing on multi-threading.
sentences.zh: 如果我们讲 Go 语言，我们应该专门做一期关于多线程的内容。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 没错，绝对应该。

sentences.en: So what are the strengths that Dart, we said it tries to do a lot of things, so what are those strengths it really shines in?
sentences.zh: 那么 Dart 的优势是什么？我们说它试图做很多事情，那么它真正闪光的地方在哪里？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I think one of the biggest strengths of Dart is that it gives you the sort of, what's a good way of describing it?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为 Dart 最大的优势之一是它为你提供了那种，怎么形容比较好呢？

sentences.en: It gives you the sort of structure that you're used to that people have been developing with for years.
sentences.zh: 它为你提供了人们多年来一直开发所习惯的那种结构。

sentences.en: You know, it's not very often that you see, you know, a 200,000 line JavaScript program.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你很少见到 20 万行的 JavaScript 程序。

sentences.en: And many JavaScript developers will say that's a good thing.
sentences.zh: 许多 JavaScript 开发者会说这是一件好事。

sentences.en: It's because we can get it done in 20 lines or something.
sentences.zh: 因为我们可以在 20 行代码左右就搞定它。

sentences.en: But the reality is, you know, if you have 30 people working on a project, you really want things to be encapsulated.
sentences.zh: 但现实是，如果你有 30 个人在一个项目上工作，你真的希望事物是封装好的。

sentences.en: Maybe that's the best word I'm really looking for.
sentences.zh: 也许这是我真正想找的最好的词。

sentences.en: So you want to be able to say, look, this is my, this is my graphics handler class for my part of this game.
sentences.zh: 所以你希望能够说，看，这是我负责这个游戏部分的图形处理类。

sentences.en: And the way you interact with me is you can say like add sprite, remove sprite.
sentences.zh: 你与我交互的方式就是调用 add sprite（添加精灵）、remove sprite（移除精灵）。

sentences.en: So I'm going to give you an interface with some functions and you can code to this interface.
sentences.zh: 所以我给你一个带有某些函数的接口，你可以针对这个接口进行编码。

sentences.en: And then, but internally, you know, I'm going to be doing all the handling of the drawing the pixels and things like that.
sentences.zh: 然后，在内部，你知道，我会处理所有绘制像素之类的事情。

sentences.en: I'm just going to expose sort of an API.
sentences.zh: 我只是暴露一个 API 而已。

sentences.en: That's sort of, that's the way a lot of these big languages work.
sentences.zh: 这正是许多大型语言的工作方式。

sentences.en: Like C++, you have the header file and you can give somebody the header file without the source file and they should be able to interact with your code, even though they don't know
sentences.zh: 比如 C++，你有头文件，你可以把头文件给别人而不需要源文件，他们应该能够与你的代码交互，即使他们不知道

sentences.en: what's happening under the hood.
sentences.zh: 底层发生了什么。

sentences.en: In the case of Java, you know, they typically use Java docs, right?
sentences.zh: 在 Java 的情况下，你知道，他们通常使用 Java docs，对吧？

sentences.en: So you can see a Java doc with the API and you can code to this API, even if you don't know what the code is doing, because it's very structured.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看到带有 API 的 Java doc，并且可以针对这个 API 进行编码，即使你不知道代码在做什么，因为它非常结构化。

sentences.en: You know, in the case of JavaScript, this doesn't really exist, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，在 JavaScript 的情况下，这并不真正存在，对吧？

sentences.en: It's JavaScript, everything is an object and there's, it's very hard, you know, you can define an API, but you're doing a lot of the heavy lifting yourself.
sentences.zh: 它是 JavaScript，一切都是对象，而且，这很难，你知道，你可以定义一个 API，但你得自己做很多繁重的工作。

sentences.en: Dart sort of takes a step back and says, let's give us more of a Java or C++ feel to browser based to client side browser computing.
sentences.zh: Dart 算是退后一步说，让我们为基于浏览器的客户端计算提供更多 Java 或 C++ 的感觉。

sentences.en: And that's something that especially if you go to working with large teams of people is something that is really beneficial.
sentences.zh: 这对于大型团队合作来说是非常有益的。

sentences.en: It also seems nice that it has the option for the static typing or the dynamic typing.
sentences.zh: 它似乎还不错，因为它提供了静态类型或动态类型的选择。

sentences.en: So if you really want dynamic typing and you're in Dart, great, use it.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在 Dart 中真的想要动态类型，很好，用它就行。

sentences.en: But if you have that static typing to enable those compile time checks and make sure you
sentences.zh: 但如果你有静态类型来启用那些编译时检查，并确保你

sentences.en: didn't just try to put a string in an integer or vice versa, or try to add three to a string,
sentences.zh: 没有试图把字符串放进整数里，反之亦然，或者试图把 3 加到一个字符串上，

sentences.en: which doesn't make a lot of sense or is ambiguous, then it's really nice to be able to have that
sentences.zh: 这没什么意义或者是有歧义的，那么能够拥有这个功能真的很棒

sentences.en: because it enables, again, if Jason wrote one piece of line of code and I wrote another and I thought he was using a string, in reality, he was using an integer, then, you know, it
sentences.zh: 因为它启用了，再说一次，如果 Jason 写了一行代码，我写了另一行，我以为他在用字符串，实际上他在用整数，那么，你知道，它

sentences.en: could be a problem.
sentences.zh: 可能会成为一个问题。

sentences.en: And so it's nice to be able to kind of have those enforcements and checks there if you want them.
sentences.zh: 所以如果需要的话，能够有这些强制执行和检查是很好的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，举个例子，假设，你知道，我正在编写这个图形引擎，而 Patrick 正在将其作为他游戏的一部分使用。

sentences.en: Um, you know, in the case of JavaScript,
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，在 JavaScript 的情况下，

sentences.zh: 我只是创建了一组函数，但我并没有真正说，哦，你知道，你必须传入两个整数和一个字符串之类的

sentences.en: that.

sentences.zh: 嗯，他在编译时肯定不会知道，因为没有编译器。

sentences.en: JavaScript's completely interpreted, right?
sentences.zh: JavaScript 是完全解释执行的，对吧？

sentences.en: But even at runtime, it could be just really like the code can just do really strange things
sentences.zh: 但即使在运行时，它也可能只是，代码可能会做一些非常奇怪的事情，

sentences.en: that you're not sure of if someone, um, you know, changes an implementation of something.
sentences.zh: 如果你不确定某人是否修改了某个实现，你就会感到困惑。

sentences.en: But with Dart, it sort of allows you to, you know, to, to create these modules.
sentences.zh: 但有了 Dart，它算是允许你，你知道，去创建这些模块。

sentences.zh: 所以它允许两个人并行工作，而无需不断保持同步。
